audit.whatIsWrong: The lane is described entirely through a 'totem' that is never an ability, and there is no cooldown sequencing anywhere.
audit.why: His threat is Purgatory (R, 120/100/80s, 1000 range) plus Ashen Pursuit (E, 10s) as the step-up; naming them turns vague advice into timing advice.
audit.corrected: Lane read: you own 1-5 at range and step up the moment Ashen Pursuit (10s) is spent; the lane turns on Purgatory at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes name 'his ult' and 'the totem' without cooldowns.
audit.why: Purgatory is 120s at rank 1 and 80s at rank 3 — the whole first-item danger spike is one 120-second button, so the downtime is a free window worth naming.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and first item are Purgatory windows on a 120s cooldown; between casts you are safe to swing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Purgatory's binding effect and Soul Ignition's delayed heal are both absent.
audit.why: Purgatory is a binding zone that slows and executes — pinned in it, Heroic Swing stops being an exit, which is exactly why the first-item spike kills you. Soul Ignition (W, 18/17/16/15/14s) costs him health up front and heals a portion back at the end, so Grievous Wounds applied before that window denies the refund.
audit.corrected: Purgatory binds you where you stand so E is not an escape; Grievous Wounds before Soul Ignition ends denies the heal-back.

edits.before: Both ultimates land and the free ride ends: his totem threat now answers your Comeuppance pressure.
edits.after: Both ultimates land and the free ride ends: Purgatory's 120s execute answers your Comeuppance.

edits.before: The danger spike of the game — Purgatory executes you before the swing gets you clear. Keep HP out of totem range.
edits.after: The danger spike — Purgatory binds you where you stand, so the swing never gets you clear. Stay out of execute HP.

edits.before: Even: your slipperiness against his burst. He kills you if he catches you; respect the totem and he rarely does.
edits.after: Even: your slipperiness against his burst. He kills you if he binds you; hold E for Ashen Pursuit, not poke.

edits.before: Level 6 evens the lane as both ultimates come online — his totem threat now answers your Comeuppance pressure.
edits.after: Level 6 evens the lane as both ultimates come online — Purgatory's execute now answers your Comeuppance pressure.

edits.before: First item is Locke's: his Purgatory spike executes you before the swing gets you clear. Keep your HP high and your E in your back pocket.
edits.after: First item is Locke's: Purgatory binds you where you stand and executes before Heroic Swing gets you clear. Keep HP high, E in reserve.

edits.before: Late settles even — your slipperiness against his burst. He kills you if he catches you, and he rarely catches you if you respect the totem.
edits.after: Late settles even — your slipperiness against his burst. He kills you if he lands Purgatory, and he rarely does if you space its 1000 range.

edits.before: This is your lane through 1-5. The double-hit Q outranges everything he has, so poke him off every last hit and punish any walk-up. Level 3 adds Heroic Swing and the full kite pattern — swing, poke, disengage, repeat. Build the lead now and keep your passive shield up for his trade attempts.
edits.after: This is your lane through 1-5. The double-hit Q outranges everything he has, so poke him off every last hit and punish any walk-up. Level 3 adds Heroic Swing and the full kite pattern — swing, poke, disengage. Throw Q the moment Ashen Pursuit (10s) is spent; that is his only step-up.

edits.before: At 6 the lane honestly resets — his ult answers yours. His first item is the danger spike of the game: Purgatory executes you before you can swing away, so hold Heroic Swing as an escape rather than a trade tool, keep your HP out of totem range, and ward the flanks he wants to come in from.
edits.after: At 6 the lane resets — Purgatory (120s at rank 1) answers your ult. Its binding zone pins you where you stand, so Heroic Swing stops being an escape: hold E until he has spent R or dashed in with Ashen Pursuit, keep your HP above execute range, and ward the flanks he comes from.

edits.before: Two items on it's even — your slipperiness against his burst. Fight where your swing has walls to work with, keep the passive shield rolling, and never take a straight burst-check while low. Your revives and mobility swing teamfights more than the 1v1 ever will, so play the map.
edits.after: Two items in it's even — your slipperiness against his burst. Soul Ignition costs him health first and heals it back at the end, so Grievous Wounds landed before that window flips extended fights. Fight where your swing has walls, and never burst-check while low.

notes: Every reference to a 'totem' has been replaced with Purgatory; nothing in Locke's kit is a totem. Packet flagged zero cooldown sequencing — Ashen Pursuit (10s) and Purgatory (120s) now anchor the timing lines.
